The '''1954 Copa del Generalísimo''' was the 52nd staging of the [[Copa del Rey|Spanish Cup]]. The competition began on 2 May 1954 and concluded on 20 June 1954 with the final.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Ferrer |first=Carles Lozano |date=2001-10-04 |title=Spain - Cup 1954 |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tabless/spancup1954.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260210135318/https://www.rsssf.org/tabless/spancup1954.html |archive-date=2026-02-10 |access-date=2026-03-21 |website=[[RSSSF]]}}</ref>
